lines.text: Every year Nora says the same thing.
Next year, the Smokies. Or Utah. Or Yellowstone.
And every year, nothing gets planned.
So this Christmas, Daniel wrapped all three.
Three trip planning guides: when to go, where to stay, itineraries built around the best day hikes, and the safety rules for each park.
On Christmas morning they circled the first dates on the calendar.
Save this for the hiker on your list.
